args: SELECT key, display_value FROM args WHERE arg_set_id IN (SELECT arg_set_id FROM slice WHERE name = 'kedra.recording') LIMIT 50
SELECT name, severity, value FROM stats WHERE value != 0 AND (severity IN ('error', 'data_loss') OR name GLOB '*overwrit*' OR name GLOB '*discard*') ORDER BY name LIMIT 200

WITH updates AS (SELECT ts, LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY ts) - ts AS dur, 'Update ' || EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id, 'debug.update') AS name FROM slice WHERE name = 'kedra.update') SELECT ts, dur, name FROM updates WHERE dur > 0 LIMIT 10000
SELECT ts, dur, 'Update ' || EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id, 'debug.update') AS name FROM slice WHERE name = 'kedra.render_cpu' LIMIT 10000
SELECT ts, dur, name, category FROM slice WHERE dur >= 100000 AND category IN ('UI', 'Rendering CPU', 'Assets', 'Scripts', 'Editor', 'Application') ORDER BY ts LIMIT 20000
